{{UI|Auction House

}}

{{UI|Create Auction
|2, 5=Stone Button, none, &eClick an item in your inventory!, &7Selects it for auction
|4, 3=Red Terracotta, none, &cCreate Auction, &7No item selected!/&5/&7Click an item in your inventory to/&7select it for this auction.
